title: NovaCRM
description: NovaCRM is an AI voice-calling and marketing-automation platform. I contributed to the V1 to V2 modernization across ~80–90 pages and 17 modules with a 3-person frontend team: JavaScript to TypeScript migration with centralized type-safe API definitions, Bootstrap to Tailwind CSS / shadcn/ui / SCSS, React Query caching with query keys and direct cache updates, JWT auth with protected routes and 401 auto-logout, real-time WebSocket upload/tag progress, multi-step React Hook Form flows, and ~40% Jest/Cypress coverage.
technologies: Next.js | TypeScript | React Query | Tailwind CSS | shadcn/ui

title: Real Estate IDX Platform
description: A multi-theme real estate IDX platform serving ~50 white-label client websites across 11 themes and ~40 pages. I architected the frontend from scratch: JWT auth with Zustand and Axios interceptors, URL-driven property search and filters that persist across refreshes, map-based MLS search with Google Maps, saved searches and email alerts, React Query caching, reusable multi-theme component patterns, and SSR with dynamic API-driven metadata and code splitting for SEO.
technologies: Next.js | TypeScript | Zustand | React Query | Google Maps API
